# cato_dns_settings (Resource)

Manages existing account DNS settings via networkConfig.dns. Destroy removes Terraform ownership and retains remote settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cato_dns_settings" "example" {
  # primary_server = "192.0.2.53"
  # secondary_server                     = "192.0.2.54"
  # suffix                               = ["example.test"]
  # accept_dns_requests_on_lan_interface_ip = false
}
# Destroy removes Terraform ownership and retains account DNS settings.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `accept_dns_requests_on_lan_interface_ip` (Boolean) Accept DNS requests sent to Socket LAN interface IP.
- `primary_server` (String) Primary DNS server. Omission clears it; secondary server and suffixes require a primary.
- `secondary_server` (String) Secondary DNS server. Omission clears it.
- `suffix` (List of String) Ordered DNS search suffixes. Omission or an empty list clears the list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Collection item IDs are opaque and must be preserved unchanged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cato_dns_settings.example ACCOUNT_ID
```
